map.在中文全角与英文半角字符间双向转换，自动处理标点与空格，常用于中英混排排版修正与: Convert bidirectionally between Chinese full-width and English half-width characters, handling punctuation and spaces automatically; commonly used for mixed Chinese-English typography fixes and database cleaning, with pure front-end local processing to protect text privacy.

map.数据清洗：从表单/Excel 导入的全角数字（１２３）转半角，避免后续数值计算报: Data cleaning: convert full-width numbers imported from forms or Excel (such as 123) to half-width to avoid errors in later numeric calculations.
